game_start.intro: Mchezo unaanza. Suti ya trump: {trump_suit} (kadi ya trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika Whist ya Kijerumani.
{phase_info}
Ushikilia {hand_size} kadi.
Cheza kadi kwa '[play N]', ambapo N ni nafasi yake katika mkono wako (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: EKIBINTU KY'OKUJIGIRIZA: Omuwanguzi wa buli kikolwa ky'okutegeka afuna kaadi ey'amaaso ate omuwanguzi n'afuna akaadi akaddako okuva mu kibinja. Ebikolobero ebiwangulwa mu kiseera kino tebitwalibwa ng'ebisaanira okuwangula.
player_prompt.phase_playing: EKISEERA KY'OKUZANGA: ekikopo kiwedde. Buli kyekubiira okuva kati kujja kubaako kye kikoze okuwangula.

next_card.playing_phase: Tewali kaadi eweereddwa - omutendera gw'okuzannya gutandise.
next_card.deck_empty: Ekisaawe tekirina kintu kyonna - tewali kaadi eweereddwa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Enkola y'okutambula etali nnungi. Kozesa '[play N]' okuzannya kaadi ya Nth mu ngalo zo.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Olina okugoberera ekyokulabirako n'okuzannya kaadi ya {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Mchezaji {winner_id} anashinda mchezo huu na {card} na kuchukua kadi iliyo wazi.

phase.learning_complete: Ekitundu eky'okuyiga kiwedde - buli kyekubiira ekisigadde kitwaliramu obuwanguzi.

draw.winner_received: You won the trick and received {card}.
draw.loser_received: You lost the trick and drew {card} from the deck.
draw.winner_preview: Kaadi eddako eri ku mutimbagano ye {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Michezo iliyoshinda hadi sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: Tewali kaadi ezinaakozesebwa mu kutegeka kino.

board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Mchezaji {player_id}: {scoring} alipata kadi (〕{tricks} jumla), {hand_size} kadi katika mkono

outcome.summary: Muda wa kujifunza - Mchezaji 0: {l0}, Mchezaji 1: {l1}. Muda wa kucheza - Mchezaji 0: {p0}, Mchezaji 1: {p1}. Mchezaji {winner_id} anashinda na {winner_tricks} kadi za kufunga!
